meta.title: How Moneo works — Expensum
meta.description: Transparency on the AI models used by Expensum, in line with the AI Act.

ComeFunzionaMoneo.title: How Moneo works
ComeFunzionaMoneo.intro: Moneo is Expensum's AI assistant 🤖. Here you'll find which models we use, what we use them for, and their limitations, in line with the transparency obligations of the AI Act (EU Regulation 2024/1689, Art. 50).

aiDisclosure.title: You are talking to an artificial intelligence
aiDisclosure.desc: Every response from Moneo — on the Telegram bot, in the web chat, and in monthly and weekly reports — is generated automatically by a language model (LLM), not by a person. We always disclose this at the first interaction and in every report.

models.title: The AI models we use

items.name: Mistral Small 3.1
items.purpose: Reading and categorizing expenses you write or photograph (receipts).

items.name: Mistral Large 3
items.purpose: Conversation with Moneo in chat: answers your questions about your finances.

items.name: Gemini 2.0 (Vertex AI)
items.purpose: Transcribing voice messages into text, before expense analysis.

models.footnote: All models used for text/photo analysis are provided by Mistral AI, a European company compliant with GDPR. Gemini 2.0 (Vertex AI) is used only for voice transcription, exclusively for PRO users.

limits.title: Known limitations
limits.desc: Moneo can make mistakes: wrong categories, amounts misread from a hard-to-read receipt, or inaccurate voice transcriptions. Always verify important financial data before making decisions based on reports or Moneo's answers. You can correct any expense or income entry at any time.
